title: CloudTwin Scenario
description: A proposed infrastructure change that has not yet been applied. Consumed by the Future Twin engine to produce a virtual future state for comparison with the Current Twin.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be '1.0.0' for this revision.

scenario_id.description: Unique scenario identifier. Convention: S01, S02, ...

name.description: Human-readable title describing the proposed change.

resource_type.description: Kubernetes or AWS resource kind targeted by this scenario.

resource.description: Name of the targeted resource (matches the 'name' field in the Twin).

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace of the targeted resource. Optional; defaults to 'default' when omitted.

description.description: Optional longer explanation of the change rationale.

Change.description: The specific property mutation proposed by this scenario.

property.description: Name of the resource property being changed.

before.description: Current (expected) value of the property. Used for conflict detection.

after.description: Proposed new value of the property.
